figurative_meaning_en: Vishnu's bed on the infinite serpent Ananta
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুরাণে বর্ণিত অনন্তশয্যায় বিষ্ণু বিশ্বরক্ষার জন্য শয়ন করেন।
তাঁর মৃত্যুর পর তিনি অনন্তশয্যায় নিদ্রিত বলে মনে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: In mythology, Vishnu reclines on the Ananta bed to preserve the universe.
After his death, he seems to be in eternal repose on the bed of infinity.
history: This idiom references Hindu mythology where Lord Vishnu rests on the thousand-headed serpent Ananta Shesha in the ocean of milk, symbolizing the preservation aspect of the universe during the intervals between creation cycles (Pralaya).
note: The idiom is deeply tied to Vaishnava traditions and is used metaphorically for eternal or divine rest.
